Long Horizon Planning for UAV Navigation.contribution: I built the simulator task, training code, and evaluation pipeline, and reproduced a released navigation baseline. My current study asks how the model should retain and use its earlier observations.
Long Horizon Planning for UAV Navigation.result: An earlier eight-step predictor had 14.57% lower feature error than copying the current observation, across 688 overlapping validation windows. In a separate longer-goal PPO experiment, the policy reached the goal in 0 of 24 training flights. Reliable navigation remains the research objective.

DifficultyPainting.contribution: I built the difficulty-prediction model and camera-to-LiDAR projection, then adapted PointPillars and SECOND to use the estimate during training and prediction.
DifficultyPainting.result: The largest gains were in pedestrian detection: PointPillars rose from 59.56 to 68.34 AP (+8.78), and SECOND from 67.90 to 73.71 (+5.81), against each backbone’s stronger UncertaintyPainting baseline. Mean 3D AP rose by 3.51 and 2.34 points. Cyclist AP increased; car AP decreased slightly. Input and augmentation changes prevent attributing the full difference to difficulty alone.

Reservoir Computing + SINDy.contribution: I used an echo state network to generate additional trajectories from incomplete, noisy observations, filtered them using rollout uncertainty, and compared the equations SINDy recovered with and without that extra data.
Reservoir Computing + SINDy.result: The additional data gave only marginal gains in equation recovery. The Lorenz fits above are almost unchanged, despite the extra generated trajectories.

CURI.contribution: I built the research runtime and its execution, verification, record-keeping, and cost-tracking tools. The runtime separates running an experiment from deciding what its result supports.
CURI.result: At half the cache budget, cumulative-attention retention scored 0% needle retrieval, matching random eviction in a three-sample test. The same run found speculative decoding slower despite 38–54% acceptance. These are bounded reproductions of known results; the case study shows the measurements.
CURI.source_label: Run report and limits of the findings
